Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study uses both DDA and PRM (Targeted) modes. DDA was used for discovery/AP-MS and PRM for validation of specific peptides. The primary workflow for the AP-MS data is DDA LFQ (spectrum counting).

scope: The ectopically expressed FLAG-tagged and endogenously expressed GT3-INCP immunoprecipitated with an anti-FLAG/anti–GT3-INCP antibody were resolved in NuPAGE 10% Bis-Tris gels
The whole-cell lysates were incubated with anti-FLAG M2 agarose beads (Sigma-Aldrich, A2220) overnight with gentle rotation at 4°C.

The precipitated proteins on the beads were eluted by competition with 3×FLAG peptides (Sigma-Aldrich, F4799). The eluted proteins were resolved in SDS-PAGE and were sent to the Taplin MS facility (https://taplin.hms.harvard.edu/home) for LC-MS/MS analysis
Affinity purification using an anti-FLAG antibody followed by MS (AP-MS) in MCF7 cells that stably expressed FLAG-tagged GT3-INCP or FLAG-tagged GFP

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry analysis was performed on material isolated via immunoprecipitation (anti-FLAG and anti-GT3-INCP) and affinity purification (AP-MS), which fits the 'affinity-purified complex scope'. While the text mentions GT3-INCP is localized in the nucleus and cytoplasm and mentions a 'chromatin fraction' for co-IP, the material actually analyzed by LC-MS/MS was the purified protein/complex eluted from beads.
